what: Hovering a row in the left vertical menu column turns on a 4px accent bar at its right edge over .3s, and a row with sub-items opens a 250px light panel attached to the column’s right edge at full screen height over .3s. Links in the panel grow an underline (2px) 0 → 100% on hover and a right chevron turns on — all .3s ease-in-out. It also opens with keyboard focus (focus-within)

options.left: Panel left position (px) — if unset, measures the right edge of the column
options.top: Top margin above the panel (px) — if omitted, matches the height of the row that opened the panel. If it differs per panel, set data-top on the panel
options.--fx-left: Left position of the panel — fx.js measures it from the right edge of the pillar (230px if absent)
options.--fx-width · --fx-panel · --fx-accent ·: Panel width (250px) · panel background (--kf-accent-soft) · bar and underline color (--kf-accent) · bar width (4px) · length · curve

use:
• Menu 1
    Sub 1Sub 2
  • Menu 2
note: The panel is position: fixed, so if the pillar (or an ancestor) has a transform, it is trapped inside. On phones (hover-less devices) a drawer menu is provided separately.
